title: Friday · inquiry questions and purposeful art
arrival: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms. Get your materials ready.
note: French 9:35–10:35, snack after recess, PE 11:10–11:50. Friday inquiry/art prepares for next week and the November 20 children’s-rights connection. No fixed inquiry submission deadline. Leadership work meeting after school 2:45–3:30 for participating students.

blocks.title: Welcome and attendance
blocks.firstAction: Answer attendance, then hand in forms.

blocks.title: Maths · two names for one amount
blocks.firstAction: Draw equal wholes divided into fourths.
blocks.notes: Begin with Monday’s actual learning. Show 9/4 = 2 1/4: two groups of four fourths and one fourth remain. Reverse with 2 2/3 = 8/3. Practise 7/2 = 3 1/2 and 3 1/4 = 13/4. Keep the whole and denominator unchanged. Exit: model 8/3 and explain 2 2/3. Provide counters/strips and oral explanation; not a dedicated GCF/LCM lesson.
studentSteps: Group the fractional parts into wholes.
Write both names and explain why they match.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: PE
blocks.firstAction: Listen to today’s activity and safety directions.
blocks.notes: Use the current teacher-selected activity and clear non-contact rules; do not assume dodgeball.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.

blocks.title: Quiet reset
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading or another calm activity.

blocks.title: Inquiry · two countries, one question
blocks.firstAction: Choose a question about a decision affecting people your age.
blocks.notes: Open the country inquiry overview. Today’s small goal: a question, two countries and a plan for checking sources. SchoolAI coaching is optional only after teacher setup and device booking are confirmed; teacher/partner questioning on paper is a full route. Suggested device window 12:45–1:45 is not booked. Extend only if the next slot is genuinely free.
studentSteps: Choose a question and two countries.
Plan where to look and one way to check information.
Save the question and next step.

blocks.title: Art · a fair chance
blocks.firstAction: Choose one right or access issue from our discussion.
blocks.notes: Make a small labelled sketch showing a fair-community design: for example, a play space with a usable entrance and quiet area. Explain who a design choice helps and a limit or trade-off. This is a short inquiry connection, not a new major project or compulsory display. May continue existing artwork instead when needed.
studentSteps: Add a label explaining who it helps.
Name one improvement or unanswered question.

blocks.title: Save, tidy and move
blocks.firstAction: Save your work, complete classroom jobs and join a short movement break when directed.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and prepare for dismissal.

backups: Use paper, oral explanation or drawings when devices are unavailable. Technology bookings are proposed, not confirmed.
Continue from actual class progress; this plan is not a claim that earlier lessons were completed.
No new homework or posting deadline is added.
